criteria.criterion: A new athena.defaults-proposal/1 record type exists in athena-data with fields id, kind (add/amend), statement, applies_to, version {from,to}, sources (intervention/introspection ids with job ids), status (pending/accepted with job/rejected with reason/withdrawn) and candidate_sha256, and is registered in the record validation and schema listing.
criteria.evidence: Read crates/athena-data/src/records.rs in the diff. It adds ProposalRecord with record, at, id, kind (Add/Amend), statement, applies_to, version (ProposalVersion from/to), sources (ProposalSource: introspection, intervention, job, at), failure_class, status (Pending / Accepted{job} / Rejected{reason} / Withdrawn), candidate_sha256 and notes. It also adds the AnyRecord::DefaultsProposal variant under the serde name athena.defaults-proposal/1, a validate() hook in AnyRecord validation, a canonical_path and a schema() entry. docs/records.md lists the schema.

criteria.criterion: Proposal generation code reads introspection cases, groups them by failure class, and proposes only when cases span at least N distinct jobs; N is a named constant.
criteria.evidence: proposals.rs defines `pub const REPEAT_THRESHOLD: usize = 3`. generate() builds by_class from records.cases (cases without a job are skipped), collects distinct job ids into a BTreeSet, and moves on to the next class when there are fewer than REPEAT_THRESHOLD.

criteria.criterion: Every proposal is validated by building a candidate defaults.toml and calling DefaultsModel::parse; the id must be unique among the model and pending proposals, the version bump is base plus one, and sources are checked with the existing evidence-after-decision rule.
criteria.evidence: In validate() (proposals.rs lines 145-235): build_candidate() is followed by DefaultsModel::parse on the candidate and a sha256 match; the version is checked against model.version+1; an add whose id already exists is refused, and an id held by another class's pending proposal is refused; each source is checked with introspect::after_start, the existing rule. generate() calls validate() before it returns any proposal.

criteria.criterion: No code in the proposal path opens defaults.toml for writing; a test asserts this on the module source.
criteria.evidence: The test the_proposal_path_never_opens_defaults_toml_for_writing uses include_str!("proposals.rs") and asserts that the code above #[cfg(test)] contains none of File::create, OpenOptions, fs::write/rename/copy/remove, write_all or set_len. The module reads defaults.toml only through git show_file, and it writes only through commit_records with record files.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test`: fixture-record tests in a temp dir show that (a) cases of one class across fewer than N jobs yield no proposal, (b) N distinct jobs yield one pending proposal citing those records, (c) repeats within the same job do not count, (d) a candidate that fails DefaultsModel::parse or cites evidence that postdates the decision is refused, (e) rejection suppresses the class until N newer distinct-job cases arrive, after which a proposal reappears.
criteria.evidence: These tests passed on tempfile::tempdir fixtures: cases_of_a_class_in_fewer_than_n_jobs_yield_no_proposal, n_distinct_jobs_yield_one_pending_proposal_citing_those_records, repeats_within_one_job_do_not_count, a_candidate_that_fails_to_parse_is_refused, evidence_that_is_not_later_than_the_decision_is_refused and a_rejection_suppresses_the_class_until_n_newer_distinct_jobs_arrive. a_rejected_class_is_proposed_again_only_after_enough_newer_jobs also passed, in a fixture git repo. The full suite passed.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test`: a test shows `athena status` (text and --json) lists open proposals with id, kind, statement, version bump and source records, and omits rejected and accepted ones.
criteria.evidence: status_lists_open_proposals_with_their_sources_and_omits_decided_ones passed. It checks the id, kind, version 1->2, the statement and the sources in display::status text, and the same fields in the serde JSON of StatusView. findings.evidence: The diff adds a proposals field to store::Records, a DefaultsProposal match arm, sorting, and a has_record_id check. This looks necessary: without the arm, the `other => job_of(&other).expect(...)` branch would panic on the new record. It is still outside the list.

findings.summary: A changed file is not on the expected deliverables list: docs/records.md
findings.evidence: The diff adds a layout line and a schema table row for athena.defaults-proposal/1. This is the 'schema listing' that criterion 1 refers to, so it is reasonable, but the file is not listed.

findings.summary: The pending-id uniqueness check in validate() skips pending proposals of the same failure class
findings.evidence: The condition `o.id == p.id && o.failure_class != p.failure_class && o.record != p.record` lets a second pending proposal of the same class with the same id pass validate(). generate() skips classes that already have a pending proposal, so this cannot happen through generation.

summary: The change builds step 3 of the defaults loop as asked. It adds a new athena.defaults-proposal/1 record in athena-data, registered in record validation, schema() and canonical_path(). A new crates/athena-core/src/proposals.rs groups recorded introspections by failure class. When a class spans REPEAT_THRESHOLD = 3 distinct jobs, it writes a pending proposal. Before writing, each proposal is checked: the candidate defaults.toml is built in memory and must pass DefaultsModel::parse, the id must be unique, the version must be the base plus one, and the existing after_start rule (evidence after the decision) is applied. `athena status` lists open proposals in both text and JSON. Accepting a proposal submits an ordinary job request that names defaults.toml as its deliverable; rejecting one records the reason and holds the class back until 3 newer distinct jobs have cases. apply_check tests a candidate file. A test scans the module's source for file-write calls. I ran `cargo test --locked -q` (everything passed), `cargo test --locked --test proposals` (5 passed), `cargo test --locked proposal` (the 11 unit tests in proposals.rs and the record test passed), clippy with -D warnings, and `cargo fmt --check`; all were clean. The design doc §12 step 3 is marked built and CHANGELOG.md has an entry. Two changed files are not on the deliverables list: store.rs, which is needed so loading the new record does not panic, and docs/records.md, which is the schema listing. Both are minor.
